tools.name: list_procedures
tools.title: List Procedures
tools.description: List every analyzed procedure as address/value pairs after provider analysis. Ghidra metadata distinguishes thunks and external functions; use returned addresses in later function operations. Select detail summary for counts and retained native-inventory pages; complete remains the default.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

__schema12.description: Verbatim direct-request path; not part of semantic identity.

__schema13.description: Verbatim auxiliary input paths keyed by argument name; repeated selections retain their order. Caller assertions are outside semantic identity.

matched_aliases.description: Procedure search only: the procedure's secondary names that matched. value stays its primary name.

path.description: Selected artifact path, or the canonical resource root when resource-only Evidence has no executable subject.

tools.name: decompile_all
tools.title: Decompile All
tools.description: Export pseudocode for all or selected analyzed functions to a directory; returns a manifest/index, with bodies kept in files. Existing output requires resume with matching target, provider, profile and layout; verified files are skipped and conflicts preserved. External functions produce no file. Item failures do not stop others; cancellation keeps written files. retry_failed: independent_fresh retries only provider-reported function failures when supported, retaining each attempt and its limitations; independent attempts may use different analysis context. layout dwarf falls back to address filenames when compilation-unit paths are unavailable. Select limit/resume to fit the whole client deadline; per-function limits do not bound the export.

output_directory.description: Absolute output directory. The parent must exist. The directory itself must be absent unless resume is true. One run at a time may use a directory; a second run is refused while the first holds it.

layout.description: address names files by canonical address. dwarf asks for compilation-unit paths and is reported unavailable when the provider has no such fact.

resume.description: Continue a journal for the same target SHA-256, provider, analysis profile, and layout. Both digests must be known. Verified files and functions recorded as external are skipped, conflicting files are left unchanged, and functions not yet tried run before retries of recorded failures.

retry_failed.description: For a null result explicitly reported as a function failure, retain the failure and try an independent decompile when supported. It can use different analysis context; errors and omissions without that typed fact are not retried.

name.description: Case-sensitive literal substring of the provider function name.

namespace.description: Case-sensitive prefix of the provider function name, including any separator such as Foo:: or Class.

address_start.description: Inclusive lower bound as 0xoffset or space:0xoffset. Must use the same address space as address_end.

address_end.description: Inclusive upper bound as 0xoffset or space:0xoffset. Must use the same address space as address_start.

limit.description: Maximum functions to attempt on this call after skipping verified files and functions recorded as external. Further matches remain for a later resume.

inputSchema.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

__schema12.description: Verbatim direct-request path; not part of semantic identity.

__schema13.description: Verbatim auxiliary input paths keyed by argument name; repeated selections retain their order. Caller assertions are outside semantic identity.

__schema17.description: Absolute directory containing the function files.

__schema18.description: Absolute path of the index. The index lists functions and does not contain pseudocode.

__schema20.description: address when files are named by address on request. debug_layout_unavailable when dwarf was requested and no compilation-unit fact exists.

excluded.description: Inventory functions excluded by the filter.

written.description: Function files created by this call.

failed.description: Functions this call could not write.

external.description: Functions this call found procedure_info classifies as external. No file is written and no pseudocode is requested. A function without a matching procedure_info classification is decompiled as usual.

skipped.description: Selected functions already settled: existing files that still hold the same bytes, whether recorded in the journal or found on disk, and functions the journal records as external.

remaining.description: Selected functions not attempted because the limit was reached.

__schema22.description: At most 32 failure details within 2,048 JSON-encoded UTF-8 bytes. Names may be omitted to preserve addresses and reasons; the index retains complete records.

name.description: Observed name, or null when unknown.

anyOf.description: Name omitted to fit the inline text budget; the index retains the full observed name.

__schema28.description: Failure records omitted from failures because of the inline count or encoded-text budget.

__schema33.description: Provider analysis-profile digest, or null when the provider did not commit one.

__schema34.description: SHA-256 of the analyzed target, or null when the observation has no file subject.

__schema35.description: Limitations reported by this call's procedure inventory. They describe the selection that produced this run, not every historical function record in the directory.

__schema37.description: Limits of this export. Pseudocode is not included.

__schema39.description: Whether this call continued a journal.
